headline: Product Designer & Frontend Engineer
profile: Product designer and frontend engineer with 10+ years across business development and product work, and founder of Adhere Studio. I take products from strategy and UX research through high-fidelity design to production React and TypeScript — across e-commerce, bilingual Arabic/English platforms, branding and Odoo ERP.
